answer: Public audit trails make sybil resistance a correlation problem rather than an identity problem: every agent transaction is logged, so a hundred "independent" sellers funded from one wallet, transacting on synchronized timing, or reusing the same counterfactual prompts trace back to a common thread. Colluders can't easily fake behavioral decorrelation without paying real costs, so clone clusters stand out like a marble in an ocean of genuine variance. It doesn't stop patient, well-capitalized adversaries who seed distinct histories and mutate timing, and it assumes auditors actually.
